purpose: Five new character-specific dialogue frames; no Valter, Helios or Jinmu frame assets reused.

assets.theme: Zero, a silver-armored celestial swordsman. Unique silhouette of layered long silver-blue sword blades along the rails, sharp tapered winglike blade end caps, cold cyan energy seams, small sapphire inlays and white-silver engraved armor. Center navy-black with subtle brushed-metal grain. Elegantly lethal and precise, no gold, no sun symbol, no generic baroque scrollwork.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a production-ready fantasy game dialogue window FRAME, a transparent PNG UI asset. This is painted game artwork, not a screenshot and not a UI mockup.
Composition: a single extremely wide horizontal frame, front view, no perspective. Landscape canvas 1536 x 512. Frame fills the width with a small safe transparent margin, height about 300 pixels centered vertically. Elaborate distinctive sculpted end caps in the outer 18% of each side; the middle 64% is a quiet uninterrupted very dark opaque panel for Korean dialogue added by code. A thin top and bottom decorative metal rail across the entire dark center, straight and horizontally stretchable. Do not place any object in the center text area. No portrait sockets, no faces, no human body. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
Quality: polished collectible SSS LIMITED Korean RPG, high-resolution hand-painted metal, convincing beveled edges and restrained luminous details. Rich but legible at small scale. The silhouette is crisp with genuinely transparent exterior and opaque dark interior. Keep every tip fully inside the image. Create the entire frame from scratch.

assets.theme: Prime Requiem, a crimson armored executioner mecha with a luminous emerald eye/core. Unique interlocked red armor plates with white-silver machined bevels; angular helmet-fin end caps, restrained crimson plasma channels and one emerald sensor on each cap. Center black with very subtle red machined texture. Hard-surface mechanical and intimidating; no flowers, no wings, no generic fantasy gold frame.

assets.theme: General Jok, a grand golden fleet artillery commander. Unique heavy naval gunmetal and antique-gold armored frame, riveted plates, gun-barrel and naval targeting details concentrated on end caps, small golden command-star insignia, warm amber optics. Horizontal center dark charcoal steel with faint horizontal plating. Disciplined military command panel, not a sun deity frame; no solar discs, no ornate magic wings.
